definitions.gloss: big profit; huge gain; making a killing
definitions.explanation: A very large profit, especially one made quickly or by luck. {大儲|おおもう}けする means to make a lot of money from a deal, a bet or a business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大儲|おおもう}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a killing on stocks.

examples.japanese: {大儲|おおもう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He went for a big profit and failed.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}って→売る：00906_uru⟧{大儲|おおもう}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧らしい。
examples.english: I hear that company made a fortune selling masks.

notes:
Colloquial in tone; news writing prefers ⟦{巨額|きょがく}→巨額：12416_kyogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大儲|おおもう}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a killing
- {大儲|おおもう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim for a big profit
- ⟦{一攫千金|いっかくせんきん}→一攫千金：18500_ikkakusenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大儲|おおもう}け: a fortune made at one stroke

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ぼろ{儲|もう}け: easy money, a windfall — stresses how little effort it took, often with disapproval
- ⟦{大損|おおぞん}→大損：31292_oozon⟧: heavy loss — the opposite
